title: Marketing website for Shree Aainath Construction

requirements.text: Create a responsive multi-section marketing website for the construction business named “Shree Aainath Construction”, with clear navigation and English user-facing copy.

quotes: Create a website for my construction business (website name ) shree aainath construction

acceptanceCriteria: The site title/branding displays “Shree Aainath Construction”.
All visible UI text is in English.
Layout is responsive for mobile, tablet, and desktop.
A top navigation allows smooth scrolling or routing to each major section/page.

requirements.text: Implement the following core content structure (single-page sections or separate routes are acceptable): Home (hero + key value proposition), About, Services, Projects (portfolio/gallery), and Contact (business contact details + inquiry form UI).

quotes: Create a website for my construction business

acceptanceCriteria: Home includes a hero area with headline, short description, and at least one call-to-action button (e.g., “Request a Quote”).
About section/page includes a company overview and highlights (e.g., experience, quality, safety).
Services lists at least 4 service cards relevant to a general construction business (generic, non-location-specific wording).
Projects section displays a grid/gallery layout with at least 6 project placeholders (title + short description) and project images (use generated/static assets).
Contact section includes clearly labeled placeholders for phone, email, and address (values can be “TBD” if not provided), plus an inquiry form UI with fields: Name, Phone, Email, Message.

requirements.text: Add a coherent, construction-themed visual design system and apply it consistently across the site (colors, typography, spacing, button styles, and section styling). Do not use a blue/purple primary palette.
acceptanceCriteria: A consistent palette is used across components (e.g., charcoal/gray + safety orange + off-white).
Typography is consistent (headings, body text, and button styles).
Buttons, cards, and section separators follow a unified style.
Design looks appropriate for a construction brand (industrial/modern feel).

requirements.text: Add static asset handling for the required generated images by placing them under frontend/public/assets/generated and rendering them in the hero, logo/brand area, and projects gallery.
acceptanceCriteria: All required generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated.
Hero uses the specified hero image (or pattern) as a background or prominent visual.
Branding area uses the specified logo image.
Projects gallery uses the specified project placeholder images without fetching from the backend.

requirements.text: Ensure the website has basic SEO and accessibility essentials: correct document title, meta description, semantic headings, alt text for images, and keyboard-navigable links/buttons.
acceptanceCriteria: Document title includes “Shree Aainath Construction”.
A meta description is present (generic business description is acceptable).
Pages/sections use semantic heading order (H1 then H2/H3).
All images have meaningful alt text.
Navigation and primary actions are usable via keyboard.

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text.
Do not edit any files under the immutable frontend paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (compose/reuse them instead).
Do not add unsupported technologies or external databases/services; keep within the provided React+TypeScript frontend and single Motoko actor backend constraints.
nonGoals: Online payments, invoicing, or e-commerce features.
Third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity would be allowed, but authentication is not required for this marketing site).
Real-time chat, push notifications, or email/SMS sending integrations.
Complex CMS/admin dashboard (content can remain static/config-driven unless explicitly requested).
